chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Salma, the companion of Al-Sabiri, from Abu Al-Sabbah Al-Kinany, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Fasting Shaban and the month of Ramadan consecutively is a repentance from Allah, by Allah!'

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Title of Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.رَمَضَانَ: The ninth month of the Islamic lunar calendar, month of fasting
key_terms.شَعْبَانَ: The eighth month of the Islamic lunar calendar

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of fasting consecutively in Shaban and Ramadan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the spiritual merit of maintaining a continuous fast from Shaban into Ramadan, framing it as a comprehensive act of repentance (*tawbah*) from Allah. The scholarly tradition highlights this continuity as a means of spiritual purification, preparing the believer for the heightened devotion of Ramadan while emphasizing the divine assurance of forgiveness through the emphatic repetition of the divine name.
